slides.body:
Onjium opened in 2013 as a research institute affiliated with the Arumjigi Culture Keepers Foundation, not as a restaurant with a research habit. Staff study centuries-old Korean cookbooks and royal court records together, and the tasting menu is what comes out the other end. The name itself means, roughly, to make something properly.

Chef Cho Eun-hee: "Korean cuisine is not a culture of overpowering flavours, but a culinary culture that uses time to perfect relationships and balance."
